n: CATEDU La aplicacion de la IA en el aula infantil y primaria
t: A Spanish online book of unplugged and hands-on AI activities for young children.
steps: Open the chapter that matches your students.
Read the activity notes in Spanish.
Gather paper and pens for the unplugged activities.
Open Teachable Machine for the hands-on chapter.
Get an Echidna board if you want to try it.
